weather_report:
Before dawn in Subiaco the air feels clean and a little brisk, the sky already hinting at a pale seam of gold. Forecasts show a clear morning unfolding into a bright, uncomplicated day, the sort where the light sharpens edges and the streets wake gently. Expect a sun-forward Thursday with a high, glassy blue and no meaningful cloud to soften it; UV will climb quickly after breakfast and sit at the fierce end of the scale through late morning and early afternoon.

It looks pleasantly crisp now and will warm with purpose, so think light layers you can shed, breathable clothes, a brimmed hat, sunglasses, and proper sunscreen. Good hours for a quiet walk to pick up bread and a newspaper, a slow lap through Kings Park before the day gleams too hard, or hanging the washing to race the sun. Run errands early, water the garden while shadows are long, then let the heat pass from a shaded veranda with a book and a tall glass of something cold.
